feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Blood tests that could spot early signs of cancers to be trialled on thousands of NHS patients
articles.summary: Blood tests that could spot the early signs of a range of the most common cancers are to be trialled on thousands of NHS patients.

articles.title: Dozens arrested outside court hearing Palestine Action ban challenge
articles.summary: Dozens of protesters have been arrested outside the Supreme Court ahead of a hearing challenging the ban on Palestine Action.

articles.title: Hair and beauty products less regulated than ballpoint pens, say MPs
articles.summary: Many hair and beauty products are less regulated than ballpoint pens and "people are suffering as a result", MPs have said.

articles.title: Police arrest fourth boy after five teenagers stabbed at Halloween party
articles.summary: Police have arrested a fourth boy after five teenagers were stabbed at a Halloween party in Chandler's Ford on Saturday.

articles.title: Poundland supplier urges 'thorough' state probe into owner's conduct
articles.summary: A major Poundland supplier has urged the government to "thoroughly investigate" the conduct of its majority owner as the discount chain teeters on the brink of collapse.

articles.title: Husband invited two men to abuse unconscious wife within an hour, court hears
articles.summary: A husband invited two men to his home to sexually abuse his unconscious wife within the space of an hour, a court has heard.

articles.title: Ukrainian GCSE to be offered to British students
articles.summary: Students in England, Wales and Northern Ireland will be able to take a Ukrainian GCSE from 2028 as part of government plans.

articles.title: Parliament risks 'catastrophic event' without urgent renovation
articles.summary: The Palace of Westminster is at risk of a "catastrophic event" if delays to a renovation initiative are not resolved, a group of MPs have warned.

articles.title: British healthcare worker tests positive for Ebola in DR Congo 'and will be treated in UK'
articles.summary: A British healthcare worker in the Democratic Republic of Congo has tested positive for Ebola and will reportedly be treated in the UK.

articles.title: Bomb threats reported on multiple flights, including two from UK airports
articles.summary: At least seven flights, including two from the UK, have been affected by bomb threats, which caused unplanned landings and temporary airport closures.
